title: edonkey: additional field parsing on udp server status and  id change packets
description:
The protocol dissector doesn't read several additional fields of both
`EDONKEY_MSG_UDP_SERVER_STATUS` (`OP_GLOBSERVSTATRES` in emule codebase)
and `EDONKEY_MSG_ID_CHANGE` (`OP_IDCHANGE`) packets.

The meaning of the additional bytes can be
found in both amule and emule codebases.
See:
- https://github.com/irwir/eMule/blob/88a8c8f2d782849642880ea616cdca60b01bd8c7/ServerSocket.cpp#L266
- https://github.com/irwir/eMule/blob/88a8c8f2d782849642880ea616cdca60b01bd8c7/UDPSocket.cpp#L328
